description: This file contains CRUD operations for managing test run records, including functions to get, create, update, and filter runs by various criteria, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas.

methods.name: get_run
methods.description: Retrieve a single run by its ID.

methods.name: get_runs
methods.description: Retrieve a list of runs, optionally filtered by status and group ID.

methods.name: create_run
methods.description: Create a new test run record in the database.

methods.name: update_run_status
methods.description: Update the status and related fields of an existing run.

methods.name: get_runs_by_test_file
methods.description: Retrieve all runs associated with a specific test file.

methods.name: get_runs_by_testcase
methods.description: Retrieve all runs associated with a specific test case.
